title: How the tree-planting program works
summary: Explains Evergreen Account tree-planting mechanics: only qualifying posted purchases count toward the cumulative planting threshold; non-purchase transactions do not. Trees are scheduled whenever eligible spend reaches each $750 multiple after transactions settle, with leftover spend carrying forward and confirmations appearing in the environmental impact view.
